name: shri-health-procurement-centre
description: Hospital procurement & inventory portal — React (Vite) + Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
